posts.title: 100 days of grief
posts.description: The dream I had about mum began with the two of us sitting amongst a group of hazy faces at an elaborate Chinese restaurant. Sucking in my stomach desperately attempting delicacy with my chopsticks, I watched her: she was gently admonishing the manager for bullying a younger server. Typical mum
